text:
maria: hey team — prepping zeta-40b for onboarding. quick sync: where are canonical weights supposed to live (HF main or S3 mirror) and who owns presign/ACL?

devin: we expect HF as source-of-truth. mirror to our s3 path: s3://redwood-artifacts/models/zeta-40b/v1/ . I'll trigger shadow-sync once HF url is in manifest.

sasha: tokenizer note: zeta uses custom_bpe.json + special unk mapping. please include tokenizer_config.json in manifest root or the loader will fallback to byte-level and break tests.

chris: permissions: infra needs 's3:GetObject' from the mirror bucket for the serving role. I'll add a bucket policy once we have final path. @devin ping me the prefix.

devin: posting HF url: https://huggingface.co/org/zeta-40b/resolve/main/pytorch_model.bin
manifest snippet I'll add:
```
weights:
  - url: https://huggingface.co/org/zeta-40b/resolve/main/pytorch_model.bin
    sha256: <TO-FILL>
tokenizer: custom_bpe.json
```
I'll run sha256 locally and paste in.

ingest-bot: CI: artifact lint passed for manifest.yml (sha256 missing) — blocking final mirror step. See CI link: https://ci.redwood/runs/1234

maria: ok @devin when you post checksum here I'll kick mirror job. also sasha can you add a quick test prompt to the eval set for tokenizer edge cases?

sasha: yes added a minimal prompt set in /evals/zeta-40b/tokenizer-smoke.json — includes emojis and mixed-case edgecases. also note: vocab_size mismatch warning appears when using hf-tokenizers 0.13. pin to 0.12 in loader for now.

devin: checksum 7f8c9a2b5d6e9f3c4b2a1e0d9c8b7a6f3e2d1c0b9a8f7e6d5c4b3a2f1e0d9c8

chris: :thumbsup: I'll add s3 bucket policy and drop a cross-account role ARN here once mirror completes.

maria: thanks. leaving this thread open for mirror completion + serving smoke. if no blockers by EOD I'll schedule canary deploy.
